bullets.text: US Firms Sue Ofcom - US companies challenge UK regulator's enforcement of the Online Safety Act, citing free speech violations.
AI Pilots' High Failure Rate - A staggering 95% of enterprise generative AI projects fail, highlighting the need for strategic implementation.
AI Chip Market Growth - Omdia forecasts the AI chip market to reach $286 billion by 2030, despite slowing growth rates.
Nvidia Eyes China Market - Nvidia's CEO hints at potential sales of Blackwell AI chips in China, pending US licensing.
Telecom Edge Cooling Solutions - Innovative cooling systems are essential for efficient AI operations at telecom edge sites.
Data Center Workforce Crisis - The data center industry faces a skilled trades shortage, impacting construction timelines.
China's Satellite Internet Plans - China accelerates development of low-orbit satellite internet to compete with **Starlink**.
AI Reshapes Banking Sector - AI tools are transforming banking operations while prompting significant workforce changes in the UK.
South Africa's Fibre Network Consolidation - Efforts underway to unify public fibre networks for improved connectivity and efficiency.
SK Telecom Fined for Breach - South Korea fines **SK Telecom** $97 million for a significant data breach affecting millions.
